g.text: Version: 1. Owner: Alex Holm, CEO. Synthetic company guidance.
Elseweek curates short European city breaks at a slower pace.
Company-wide tone: calm, concrete and specific.
No unsupported price, availability or booking guarantees.
Averill is the assistant. Elseweek is the fictional customer.
The demo website has no booking, payment or enquiry backend.
Palette and mark follow the existing Elseweek website design system.
